mathematical_contract.cache_key: Candidates are shared only when the complete exact coefficient vector of the source defining polynomial is equal. Projectively equivalent but differently scaled polynomials do not share state.
mathematical_contract.isolator_independence: Each source root retains and refines its own exact isolating interval. No local image interval, root choice, or parameter-specific ordering is cached across roots.
mathematical_contract.quotient_authority: For one defining polynomial P and rational map N/D, quotient-ring multiplication matrices and the exact global det(N-uD) coefficient vector are polynomial/map invariants and may be reused across every isolated root of P.
mathematical_contract.publication: Each image still requires the existing local Bernstein one-variation proof, nonzero endpoints, nonzero global leading coefficient, and containment in that root's selected exact image interval before an algebraic parameter is published.
mathematical_contract.fallback: A failed local proof still enters the complete exact image-polynomial/root replay. Cached negative construction results are invariants of the same exact polynomial/map/policy tuple, not inferred geometric negatives.
mathematical_contract.policy: Each map owns its CurveContext. STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512 execute the same exact construction and topology graph; only an unresolved terminal equality/sign may consume the 512-bit policy, and no cached approximate fact can answer STRICT.
mathematical_contract.lifetime: All cached algebra belongs to one Boolean/intersection operation and is released with that operation. It is not attached to authored curves or global state.
